create_tensor_feature: create a tfds Tensor feature with shape, dtype, and encoding for storing array data
encode_tensor_example: encode a numpy array example into serialized bytes or protobuf-compatible format for tfds
decode_tensor_example: decode a tfexample tensor back into a tensorflow tensor with proper shape and dtype
decode_tensor_numpy: decode a serialized tensor example into a numpy array with zlib decompression support
build_tensor_from_json: build a Tensor feature from JSON content or protobuf TensorFeature for deserialization
